fields.name: ArgentSea.Orleans package dependency set
fields.description: The external and internal dependencies ArgentSea.Orleans.csproj declares: three Microsoft Orleans packages pinned to one version, a single project reference to ArgentSea core, the packed non-code files (each with its own pack flag and package path), and the internal-visibility grant that lets the package's Test project see its internal types. The set names Orleans and ArgentSea core and no database-platform package or project (no SqlClient, Npgsql, ArgentSea.Sql, or ArgentSea.Pg reference) — see the companion Invariant.
